title: C4.1.7 coding band: R50 and above

rows.note: LR, MR, HR take R80 standards (Table 2B note)
R100-SL lots are under 100 m2, so the 100 m2 floor could never be met; treated as outside C4.1.7

source.file: Residential Design Codes Chapter 2 - Single Houses.pdf

verified.note: Helper table. C4.1.7 says 'R50 and above' with no carve-out; treating R100-SL as false is an interpretation (its 80m2 minimum sits under the 100m2 floor of C4.1.7(i)).

notes: Engine helper, not a published table: true where the clause's coding band applies, false otherwise (default false). Used as a condition inside the concession exceptions on C4.1.1, C4.1.1-r1 and C4.1.1-r4 (a table-lookup with no fact answers MEETS when the value is truthy), because exceptions cannot carry a coding of their own. Values are never null so a composite condition cannot pass on NOT_APPLICABLE. C4.1.7: gold-level accessible (C2.7.1) or small dwelling (C2.9.1) at R50 and above.
